title: docs(time): correct the positive-offset UTC example
body:
## Summary

Correct `docs/operations/timezones.md`: +02:00 is ahead of UTC, so 09:00 at that offset maps to 07:00Z, not 11:00Z.

The old explanation reverses the offset direction and can mislead an operator reading logs.

Validation plan: subtract two hours from the local clock and check that both corrected sentences agree. No executable test run is proposed because only guide prose changes. Named zones and daylight-saving transitions remain outside this fixed-offset example.

files.patch:
diff --git a/docs/operations/timezones.md b/docs/operations/timezones.md
--- a/docs/operations/timezones.md
+++ b/docs/operations/timezones.md
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 # Reading offset timestamps
 
-An offset of +02:00 is two hours behind UTC.
-For example, 09:00+02:00 corresponds to 11:00Z on the same date.
+An offset of +02:00 is two hours ahead of UTC.
+For example, 09:00+02:00 corresponds to 07:00Z on the same date.
 
 The examples use fixed offsets rather than named time zones.
